bullrush_reference.summary: Bull Rush: players line up at one end of the field, a catcher (or catchers) stands in the middle; runners cross to the far side without being tagged, and anyone caught joins the catchers. Last runner wins.
Te Ara (NZ encyclopedia) childhood games page, surfaced by search as covering Bullrush; page content not read (site returned 403 to curl), so treat as a pointer only.

British Bulldog: two safe zones at opposite ends of the field, one or two bulldogs in the middle; the rest run between the zones and any tagged become bulldogs. The two-zone layout is from British Bulldog, which Bullrush closely mirrors.
